intro: Every industry moves differently. These are the ways ITrackZen is typically configured, from the alerts and sensors to the reports that matter most.

items.title: Logistics Companies
items.summary: End-to-end visibility from warehouse to final destination.
points: Live ETA visibility and proof of delivery trails
Geofences for depots, ports and customer sites
Fuel and idle-time control across mixed fleets

items.title: Transport Companies
items.summary: Keep long-distance and regional transport on schedule.
points: Maintenance reminders by distance and engine hours

items.title: Taxi & Ride-Hailing Fleets
items.summary: Manage drivers, vehicles and trip integrity.
points: Live availability and location of every vehicle

items.title: Delivery Companies
items.summary: Faster dispatch and fewer missed drop-offs.
points: Track vans and motorcycles in one view
Compact trackers for riders and bikes

items.title: Construction Fleets
items.summary: Protect heavy equipment and control site costs.
points: Asset and machinery tracking with battery trackers

items.title: Fuel Tankers
points: Fuel level and discharge monitoring where sensors are fitted
Engine cut-off support on compatible installs

items.title: Buses & Public Transport
points: In-cabin and road cameras for passenger safety

items.title: Government Fleets
items.summary: Accountability and cost control for public-sector vehicles.
points: Role-based access for departments and supervisors
Audit-ready trip, fuel and usage reports
Clear driver accountability with ID support

items.title: Security Companies
items.summary: Coordinate patrols, escorts and rapid response.
points: Live location of patrol and escort vehicles
SOS and panic alerts to control rooms
Geofenced patrol zones with compliance reports

items.title: Rental Car Companies
items.summary: Know where your cars are and how they are used.
points: Mileage and usage reports for billing
Ignition and engine cut-off support where fitted

items.title: Personal Vehicle Tracking
items.summary: Peace of mind for family cars, bikes and valuables.

items.title: Cross-Border Fleet Tracking in Africa
items.summary: One account for trucks moving through multiple countries.
points: Follow trucks across corridors and borders
Border and port geofences with dwell-time reports
Multi-country fleets and users in one dashboard
Hardware options for remote areas and variable coverage
